signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 8 US offices
Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

roles.title: Presales / Product Manager (Anaplan & Pigment)
roles.location: Atlanta; Boston; Charlotte; Chicago; Dallas; Los Angeles; New York; San Francisco

bullets: Partner with our alliance and business development teams to own the solution side of the sales process: discovery, tailored demos, and proof-of-concept workshops
Design and deliver narrative-driven demonstrations that speak directly to a prospect’s pain points, rather than walking through features
Present with confidence and command the room in front of client stakeholders, from finance practitioners to senior executives
Translate a prospect’s business challenges into a clear, compelling vision of the solution

roles.title: AI Product Manager
roles.location: Atlanta; Boston; Charlotte; Chicago; Dallas; Los Angeles; New York; San Francisco

bullets: Interface with executive clients, garner trust in our services, and fill in your own knowledge gaps in real time.
Translate ambiguous client problems into clear engineering requirements: PRDs, user stories and functional specs (and do it fast)
Run client discovery sessions and earn trust quickly, including with CFOs and PE operators
Own sprint planning and delivery coordination across your pod’s AI engineers and data scientists
Define success criteria and KPIs for AI-powered features before they are built, not after
